name: Passkey Sign-In
summary: Registers the existing anonymous passwordless passkey authentication path that validates the assertion, resolves the durable user, advances the signature counter, and returns the application landing result.
notes: The current implementation is the established PasskeyController to IAppUserPasskeyManager boundary rather than an IAuthenticationFlowHandler adapter.

sourceReferences.note: Anonymous passwordless begin and complete endpoints delegate to IAppUserPasskeyManager.
Consumes and validates challenges, resolves the credential to one durable user, validates the WebAuthn assertion, advances the signature counter, and resolves the landing destination.
